name: Liliana, Death's Majesty
oracle_text:
+1: Create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token. Mill two cards.
−3: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. That creature is a black Zombie in addition to its other colors and types.
−7: Destroy all non-Zombie creatures.
blocked_sentences: −3: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. That creature is a black Zombie in addition to its other colors and types.

needs.what: a one-shot effect that permanently adds a color to one permanent ("that creature is black in addition to its other colors") without touching its card types or base power/toughness, applied to the creature card the same loyalty ability just returned from the graveyard (named by the ability's target t1)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: add_subtype covers the Zombie half (types added, duration permanent) but writes subtypes only. animate is the only one-shot that writes colors: a non-exact animate adds its colors, but the loader refuses it without power and toughness whenever the animation includes Creature (and an empty types list defaults to Creature), so it would overwrite the returned creature's base P/T; keep_colors is legal only on an exact animation, which replaces colors and types rather than adding. The set_colors static replaces colors and lasts only while its source is on the battlefield. return_from_graveyard and put_onto_battlefield carry no color option. Same gap as necromantic_selection.
